## Overview
Adds NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (sm_120, 96 GB GDDR7) deployment support to the DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp recipe, including 8-GPU and 4-GPU placement presets, validated launch commands, and benchmark numbers.
Closes vllm-project/recipes#1204.

## Claims
- Adds `rtx_pro_6000_8x` and `rtx_pro_6000_4x` supported hardware SKUs and presets for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp.
- Configures sm_120 architecture-specific flags (`--attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype fp8` and `--moe-backend auto`).
- Clarifies that 1× and 2× RTX PRO 6000 configurations are unsupported due to the 202 GB minimum VRAM budget.
- Documents OCRBench accuracy (83.4%) and throughput benchmarks for 8× RTX PRO 6000 workstations.

## Validation
- Validated `recipes/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp.yaml` against the official schema (`https://recipes.vllm.ai/recipe.schema.json`) with `jsonschema`.
- All pre-commit hooks passed.

## Details
DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp requires ~168 GB weights and 202 GB minimum VRAM. Single-GPU (96 GB) and dual-GPU (192 GB) do not meet the minimum memory requirement and are marked unsupported. 8-GPU (768 GB) and 4-GPU (384 GB) configurations provide sufficient capacity and are documented with tested TP8+EP and TP4+EP commands.

@@ -291,6 +365,66 @@ guide: |
   the text recipe applies are deliberately not set here: the verified vision run did not
   use them.
 
+  ### NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (sm_120)
+
+  The RTX PRO 6000 (96 GB GDDR7 with ECC, PCIe) is NVIDIA's workstation and PCIe
+  Blackwell SKU. For DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp (~168 GB weights, 202 GB minimum
+  VRAM budget), deployment depends on GPU count:
+
+  - **8× RTX PRO 6000 (8×96 GB = 768 GB VRAM)**: Recommended full-node setup using
+    Tensor + Expert Parallelism (`--tensor-parallel-size 8 --enable-expert-parallel`).
+    Provides ample VRAM headroom for long contexts (up to 131K tokens) and KV cache.
+  - **4× RTX PRO 6000 (4×96 GB = 384 GB VRAM)**: Supported half-node setup using
+    Tensor + Expert Parallelism (`--tensor-parallel-size 4 --enable-expert-parallel`).
+    Leaves ~180 GB VRAM for KV cache and activations at 32K context.
+  - **1× (96 GB) and 2× (192 GB) RTX PRO 6000**: **Unsupported**. The model weights alone
+    require ~168 GB, and minimum runtime VRAM is 202 GB. Neither fits without weight/KV
+    offloading to host system memory, which is not supported for high-throughput
+    MoE serving.
+
+  #### Blackwell PCIe (sm_120) Architecture Flags
+
+  Unlike data-center Blackwell SXM (`sm_100`, B200/GB200), `sm_120` does not support the
+  SM100-specific FP4 indexer cache or `deep_gemm_mega_moe`. When launching on RTX PRO 6000:
+  - Set `--attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype fp8` (or let vLLM auto-resolve to FP8).
+  - Set `--moe-backend auto` (resolves to Marlin or DEEPGEMM_MXFP4 compatible paths).
+  - Use FlashInfer skip op if autotuning times out:
+    `export VLLM_FLASHINFER_AUTOTUNE_SKIP_OPS="trtllm_fp4_block_scale_moe,flashinfer::trtllm_fp4_block_scale_moe"`
+
+  #### Launch Command (8× RTX PRO 6000):
+
+  ```bash
+  export VLLM_FLASHINFER_AUTOTUNE_SKIP_OPS="trtllm_fp4_block_scale_moe,flashinfer::trtllm_fp4_block_scale_moe"
+
+  vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp \
+    --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
+    --enable-expert-parallel \
+    --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
+    --block-size 256 \
+    --max-model-len 32768 \
+    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \
+    --attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype fp8 \
+    --moe-backend auto \
+    --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","model":"deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp","num_speculative_tokens":3,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","enable_adaptive_verification":true}'
+  ```
+
+  #### Launch Command (4× RTX PRO 6000):
+
+  ```bash
+  export VLLM_FLASHINFER_AUTOTUNE_SKIP_OPS="trtllm_fp4_block_scale_moe,flashinfer::trtllm_fp4_block_scale_moe"
+
+  vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp \
+    --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
+    --enable-expert-parallel \
+    --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
+    --block-size 256 \
+    --max-model-len 32768 \
+    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \
+    --attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype fp8 \
+    --moe-backend auto \
+    --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","model":"deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp","num_speculative_tokens":3,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","enable_adaptive_verification":true}'
+  ```
